description: Review knowledge/document operations, freshness, ownership and retrieval gaps.

provenance.author: LiNKskills Library
provenance.source: Pinned upstream modules copied with licenses and exact commit identities; see references/upstream/SOURCE-MANIFEST.json
provenance.license: See per-source upstream license copies and manifest

routing.when_to_use: Review knowledge/document operations, freshness, ownership and retrieval gaps.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own skill
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block the affected conclusion, not harmless drafting
ambiguity_rules: Read existing authorized evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

required_inputs.name: task_inputs
required_inputs.description: knowledge inventory and audience; owner/source/admission metadata; retrieval and freshness evidence

expected_outputs.name: work_product
expected_outputs.description: knowledge gap and ownership register; freshness/retrieval improvement plan; Librarian intake package

forbidden_actions: Unapproved payments, filings, postings, signatures, purchases, external announcements or production changes
Inventing source facts, approval or canon
verification_steps: Inventory authorized knowledge metadata using an explicit reproducible as-of date: title/path, named owner, date, criticality, links and available usage window. Distinguish critical operating knowledge, core material, reference and historical archive; keep unknown classification visible.

Apply the owner-approved freshness policy by tier; propose one if absent without presenting upstream intervals or scores as adopted policy. Review load-bearing stale guidance before historical low-risk records.
Inspect missing owners, dead links, orphaned resources and duplicate topics. Use available traffic evidence to distinguish a navigation gap from unused material; missing usage is unknown, not zero.

Rank remediation by criticality, evidence, usage and effort. For genuine duplicates preserve useful content and stable navigation through the supported owner route; the Librarian retains admission and canon decisions.

Return the dated health/gap report, bounded remediation backlog, named accountable owners and follow-up date. No deletion, archiving, redirects or canon changes without the required owner authority; use the same as-of convention for comparable reassessment.
completion_criteria: Task output meets contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Sources, uncertainty, exact completion scope and remaining decisions visible
Any authorized draft write read back
known_limitations: Structural qualification does not prove every behavior
Source originals are provenance; canonical method owns execution
Specialist content/draft access may be Sara-mediated

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
